name: Agent Substrate
description: High-density runtime that multiplexes many stateful agents onto few Kubernetes workers.
descriptionZh: 高密度运行时，把大量有状态 Agent 复用到少量 Kubernetes worker 上。
keyFact: Agent Substrate is an Apache-2.0 runtime that suspends idle agent 'actors' and resumes them in under a second, letting it multiplex roughly 250 stateful agents onto 8 Kubernetes pods; Google states it achieves about 10x higher density than standard container runtimes.
keyFactZh: Agent Substrate 是 Apache-2.0 许可的运行时，会挂起空闲的 Agent actor 并在 1 秒内恢复，从而把约 250 个有状态 Agent 复用到 8 个 Kubernetes Pod 上；Google 称其密度约为标准容器运行时的 10 倍。
caveat: Google open-sourced it but states it is not an officially supported Google product and was in early development (not production-ready) at verification time.
caveatZh: Google 开源了该项目，但声明其并非 Google 官方支持产品，且核验时处于早期开发阶段（尚未生产可用）。
